sections.heading: What is Bifidobacterium infantis
paragraphs: Bifidobacterium infantis is a probiotic strain found naturally in the gut of infants and in breast milk. As an ingredient it is supplied as a freeze-dried powder with a stated viable cell count.
Probiotic buyers specify the strain by its cell count, so tell us the count your formula needs when you ask for a quote.
